staticText: Pregnancy Food Variety Planner for /tools/pregnancy-nutrition/. It creates a local discussion card from broad food-group and food-safety selections. It must never calculate or prescribe calories, weight gain, protein, iron, folic acid, vitamin or supplement doses; diagnose deficiency or malnutrition; judge a diet adequate; recommend food or supplements around a pregnancy complication; or replace maternity, pharmacy or dietetic care. Diabetes, high blood pressure, anaemia, severe vomiting, kidney or liver disease, allergy, eating disorders, undernutrition, multiple pregnancy and other complications require individualized professional care. Food examples are optional prompts and must not imply one universal African diet or guaranteed availability. Do not infer pregnancy outcomes or claim a selected food is safe for an individual. Food and supplement selections are sensitive: do not save, put in URLs, send to analytics, upload, sync or require an account. Exports are local and user initiated.
